audit.whatIsWrong: report[14].t quoted 56.79% WR; the packet says 53.09% over 194 games.
audit.why: One number, taken from the data already in the packet.
Kassadin edges level 1 on range, level 2 is even, Yi owns 3 through first item, and Kassadin reclaims at 2+ items. Chart matches the packet and the full/content layers agree row for row.
audit.corrected: No change to the level chart.

audit.why: Spikes are stated correctly on both sides — Yi at 6 and first on-hit item, Kassadin at 6 and again at the 2-item Riftwalk-stacking mark. Riftwalk's rank cooldowns (5/3.5/2) were missing and are now written in.
audit.corrected: Riftwalk's real cooldowns added to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page states in six places that Null Sphere silences and that the silence cancels Alpha Strike. Riot's description says it deals damage and INTERRUPTS CHANNELS, then shields him — no silence. Also, the page attributes the shield to his passive; Void Stone is flat magic damage reduction, the shield comes off Q.
audit.why: The real interaction is the opposite of what was written: Null Sphere cannot stop Alpha Strike, but it does cancel Meditate, which is Yi's channel. That changes the advice from 'don't engage into Q' to 'don't heal into Q'.
audit.corrected: phases[0].why, phases[1].why, dontsFull[0].d, report[3].t, report[5].t, content.early, whys[0] and spikes[0].text all rewritten around channel-interrupt plus the 650-vs-600 range gap. Nether Blade (W) auto reset, 7s, written into breakdown.trading as the burst tell.

audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s — the chase window is the instant after he blinks, not a long cooldown to wait out. Null Sphere is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of Nether Blade as the burst tell.
audit.why: Kassadin's step-up damage opens with an auto-attack reset on a 7s cooldown; the wind-up animation is the cue to disengage, not the ability cast.

edits.before: At level 1 his Null Sphere Q out-ranges my autos and his passive magic shield soaks my poke, so he last-hits safely while I have no Wuju Style yet to threaten him.
edits.after: At level 1 Null Sphere reaches 650 against my 600 Alpha Strike and its shield soaks the poke, so he last-hits safely while I have no Wuju Style yet to threaten him.

edits.before: Level 2 is a wash — if I get E or W first I can short-trade, but his Q silence still shuts off my Alpha Strike, so neither of us commits.
edits.after: Level 2 is a wash — if I get E or W first I can short-trade, but his Q returns in 8.5s and shields the damage back, so neither of us commits.

edits.before: Track Riftwalk (R) cooldown above all — once it's down he has no escape from my Alpha Strike chase; pre-6 track his Null Sphere (Q) since that silence is the only thing that interrupts my engage.
edits.after: Track Riftwalk (R) above all — 5s at rank 1 falling to 2s at rank 3, so my chase window is the instant after he blinks; pre-6 track Null Sphere (Q), 9s at rank 1 and his only answer to my step-up.

edits.before: My trade is: walk up only when his Q is on cooldown, E Wuju Style on, Alpha Strike in for the on-hit + reset, auto twice, and Meditate or back off before his Q comes back up. Never auto-walk into a charged Q.
edits.after: My trade is: step up when his Q is down, E Wuju Style on, Alpha Strike in for the on-hit, auto twice, and leave before Q returns. His damage opens with the Nether Blade (W) auto reset on 7s — that wind-up is the cue to back out.

edits.before: Null Sphere silences and shields — if you Alpha Strike into an up Q you get silenced mid-reset and eat free poke; only engage after he's spent it.
edits.after: Null Sphere shields him and interrupts channels — walk in on an up Q and you eat the poke and lose the Meditate; take your trade in the 9s after he spends it.

edits.before: Trade only when his Null Sphere is on cooldown — E on, Alpha Strike in, two autos, out; back off entirely when Q is up (silence cancels my engage) and never extend a fight past the point his Riftwalk can disengage and turn.
edits.after: Trade in the 9s after his Null Sphere — E on, Alpha Strike in, two autos, out; it shields him and cancels Meditate if I try to heal through it, and never extend past the point Riftwalk lets him disengage and turn.

edits.before: Alpha Strike makes me untargetable to dodge his Q-W-R burst, but his Null Sphere silence interrupts the engage if I mistime it; my Wuju Style true damage ignores armor he can't build, while his passive magic shield specifically soaks my magic-on-hit and his Riftwalk hard-counters my chase-and-reset.
edits.after: Alpha Strike makes me untargetable to dodge his Q-W-R burst; Null Sphere does not silence — it interrupts channels, so it kills Meditate, not my engage. Wuju Style's true damage ignores the armour he can't build, while Void Stone's magic reduction and his Q shield blunt magic on-hit and Riftwalk counters my chase.

edits.before: FAVOURED (56.79% WR) — a clean lane-phase win for Master Yi that I must cash in before Kassadin's 2-item scaling and Riftwalk kite reclaim the game.
edits.after: FAVOURED (53.09% WR) — a clean lane-phase win for Master Yi that I must cash in before Kassadin's 2-item scaling and Riftwalk kite reclaim the game.

edits.before: Kassadin's Null Sphere silence edges the level-1 trade.
edits.after: Kassadin's Null Sphere out-ranges your level-1 trade.

edits.before: Level 1 Kassadin can still trade with Null Sphere's silence, but from level 2-3 onward you crush him; his pre-6 laning is famously the weakest window in the game.
edits.after: Level 1 Kassadin trades with Null Sphere at 650 range against your 600, but from level 2-3 you crush him; his pre-6 laning is famously the weakest window in the game.

edits.before: Pre-6 Kassadin is one of the weakest laners in the game; his Null Sphere silence is his only tool, so once you have Wuju Style you dominate every trade.
edits.after: Pre-6 Kassadin is one of the weakest laners in the game; Null Sphere interrupts channels, so never Meditate in his face — with Wuju Style up you win every trade.

notes: Systematic error corrected: Null Sphere was described as a silence in six places. Riot's text gives it channel interruption and a magic shield, no silence — so it cancels Meditate, not Alpha Strike. Win rate in report[14].t was 56.79% against a packet value of 53.09%; fixed. The full-layer entry exists on Yi's side even though the mirror notes CHAMP_FULL.kassadin has no masteryi key.
